lines: No flame. No frost. No storm. Just a body, a will, and a lifetime of practice.
You don't use any influence at all?
I never needed to. The basics, mastered, are a power of their own.
dialogues.accept: Good. Stand ready, and don't blink.
dialogues.farewell: The road will still be here. So will I.

lines: You stand like someone who has fought a hundred battles and learned from none of them.
Harsh is how lessons stick. Shall I teach you one?
dialogues.accept: Lesson one: everything you think you know is about to be tested.
dialogues.farewell: Pride is a heavy pack. Set it down sometime.

lines: Every Master you face hides behind a gift: fire, water, shadow.
My team has no such shelter. We are simply very, very good.
dialogues.accept: Simple is not the same as easy. Begin!
dialogues.decline: I believe you. From over here.
dialogues.farewell: Wise. Simplicity has humbled greater fighters than you.

lines: Breathe in. Breathe out. Do you feel that?
Nothing. That is the point. An empty mind is a sharp one.
dialogues.challenge: My mind's sharp enough. Fight me.
dialogues.accept: We shall see how long it stays that way.
dialogues.decline: I think I'll keep my thoughts, thanks.
dialogues.farewell: Then go and fill your head. Come back when it's quiet.

lines: They call me Unbound because no influence holds me, and no master but myself commands me.
And what does discipline say about me?
dialogues.accept: It says you talk too much. Show me instead.
dialogues.farewell: Discipline says you'll be back. It is rarely wrong.

lines: You walk into my camp unannounced? Bold. Or stupid.
Then you're both. I respect that.
dialogues.accept: HA! Burn bright, challenger. It won't last long!
dialogues.farewell: Run, then. The fire always catches up.

lines: Do you smell that? Ash and iron. The scent of victory.
Everything near me is on fire. You'll get used to it. Briefly.
dialogues.accept: Everyone says that. Right before they melt.
dialogues.decline: I'll stay out of the kitchen.
dialogues.farewell: Smart. Cowardly, but smart.

lines: I have burned through forty challengers this season.
Their ashes taught me nothing. Will yours?
I'm not planning on becoming ashes.
dialogues.challenge: I'll be the one you remember.
dialogues.accept: Then make it a blaze worth remembering!
dialogues.decline: I'd rather not be number forty-one.
dialogues.farewell: Forty-one can wait. The flames are patient. I am not.

lines: Fire doesn't ask permission. It doesn't hesitate. It takes.
And when there's nothing left to burn?
Then it finds something new. Like you.
dialogues.accept: Gladly! Stoke the flames!
dialogues.farewell: Everyone is flammable, challenger. Remember that.

lines: I was born in a forge and raised in a wildfire. I carry that spark everywhere.
I think you'll need more than courage to touch me.
dialogues.challenge: Courage and a plan. Let's go.
dialogues.accept: A plan! How adorable. Into the fire with you!
dialogues.decline: Fair point. I'll work on the plan.
dialogues.farewell: Plan all you like. Fire still burns.

lines: There are no fish. This is solid ice.
Then you'll scare me. That would be a first.
dialogues.accept: Hm. Bait taken. Brace yourself.
dialogues.decline: I'll leave you to your fishing.
dialogues.farewell: The ice remembers footsteps. So do I.

lines: Patience is a blade of ice. It forms slowly, and it never forgives.
I noticed. It is why you will lose.
dialogues.challenge: Then let's get this over with fast.
dialogues.accept: Fast. Slow. The cold comes for all.
dialogues.farewell: Good. Practice where it's warm.

lines: I once waited nine days on a frozen lake for a single strike.
Everything I have ever aimed at. Shall I aim at you?
dialogues.accept: I always do. Do not move.
dialogues.farewell: Then do not wander my waters again unprepared.

lines: Your breath fogs. Your fingers shake. You are already losing to the cold.
dialogues.accept: As you wish. Winter begins.
dialogues.farewell: Come back with thicker boots, and thicker courage.

lines: The frost does not rage like fire. It does not roar like the storm.
It simply waits until everything stops moving.
dialogues.accept: Everything stops eventually. Let us begin.
dialogues.farewell: Moving away. As expected.

lines: BOOM! BOOM-BOOM! Do you hear it? The rhythm of the sky!
Then dance with me, challenger! Let's see if you can keep the beat!
dialogues.accept: THAT'S THE SPIRIT! Thunder, on my count!
dialogues.farewell: Ha! Come back when you find your rhythm!

lines: Every storm starts with a single drop. Then the drumbeat builds...
dialogues.accept: You want the crescendo? You GOT it!
dialogues.farewell: The storm always plays an encore. You'll hear it!

lines: Lightning never strikes the same place twice. Do you know why?
Because the first strike is usually enough!
dialogues.accept: Oh, I CAN. Lightning, LET'S GO!
dialogues.farewell: Smart move. Stay away from tall trees!

lines: The sky speaks in thunder. I'm just its biggest fan.
You're very loud for a fan.
dialogues.accept: NOW you're speaking my language!
dialogues.farewell: Your loss! The show must go on!

lines: My drums have shaken mountains, scattered armies, and woken the dead.
They were VERY annoyed. Want to see what made them so mad?
dialogues.accept: Brace yourself! This one goes to eleven!
dialogues.farewell: Fine, fine. Quiet hours start... never!

lines: Sorry. I was listening to the stone. It says you are very small.
dialogues.accept: Stubborn is good. Stone is stubborn too. Let us see who lasts.
dialogues.decline: I'll go be small somewhere else.
dialogues.farewell: The mountain does not chase. It waits.

lines: I have carried this mountain on my back for a hundred years.
Yes. Now imagine what my fists feel like.
dialogues.accept: Hmm. Brave pebble. Let us begin.
dialogues.farewell: Imagining is safer. The mountain approves.

lines: Rivers bend. Trees fall. Storms pass.
dialogues.challenge: And I'm here to break it.
dialogues.accept: Many have said this. Their tools are still stuck in my sides. Come.
dialogues.farewell: Today. Tomorrow. Stone does not mind the difference.

lines: You walked a long way to stand before me.
Good. Strong legs. You will need them to run.
dialogues.accept: Then stand. Like a mountain. We will see.
dialogues.farewell: Slowly. The path is rocky. Like me.

lines: I was carved from the first mountain I ever climbed. I am only its shadow.
dialogues.accept: Climbers fall. Let us see how far.
dialogues.farewell: Then stay low, little one. The ground is kind.

lines: Ahoy, landlubber! Come to test the depths, have ye?
The sea's taken better sailors than you. But I'm feelin' generous.
dialogues.accept: HAR! All hands, brace for impact!
dialogues.farewell: Then stay ashore, and mind the tide!

lines: This anchor's been to the bottom of the deepest trench and back.
To drag challengers down with it, of course!
dialogues.accept: Hold yer breath, friend. Here we go!
dialogues.farewell: Floatin's for driftwood. Come back when ye've got some weight to ye.

lines: The tide comes in. The tide goes out. It never asks if ye're ready.
And neither do you, I'm guessing.
dialogues.accept: Here she comes! Swim or sink!
dialogues.farewell: Low tide's when the sharks come out. Choose wisely.

lines: Do ye hear the whales singin'? They sing of the deep, and the things down there.
That the deep forgives nothin'. Shall we test the song?
dialogues.accept: Then sing with me, challenger! Into the abyss!
dialogues.farewell: Aye. The song's best heard from shore.

lines: I've wrestled krakens, outswum storms, and lost three boots to eels.
The eels are sore losers. Like you'll be!
dialogues.accept: Batten down the hatches!
dialogues.farewell: Keep 'em dry, landlubber!

lines: Careful where you step. You're standing on my seedlings.
No one ever does. That's why my thorns grow so sharp.
dialogues.accept: Root and blade, then. Let the garden bloom!
dialogues.farewell: Mind the roses on your way out. They bite.

lines: A good gardener knows when to nurture... and when to cut.
That depends on how you fight.
dialogues.accept: Bloom or wilt, challenger. The kama decides.
dialogues.farewell: Then grow somewhere else, little sprout.

lines: Every weed believes it's a flower.
And what do you do with weeds?
I trim them. Very, very neatly.
dialogues.accept: We'll see what you are when the petals settle.
dialogues.decline: I'll stay out of your garden.
dialogues.farewell: Wise. The vines remember trespassers.

lines: Every root in this forest knows my name. Everything green answers to me.
dialogues.challenge: Careful, but not scared. Fight me.
dialogues.accept: Lovely. The forest has been hungry.
dialogues.farewell: The wild lets you go. This time.

lines: Spring grows. Summer blooms. Autumn harvests.
Winter is what happens to those who challenge me unprepared.
dialogues.accept: Then it's harvest time!
dialogues.farewell: Spring always comes. So will you.

lines: You... are not supposed to be here. Neither am I.
Where are you supposed to be?
Nowhere. It is very quiet there. Would you like to visit?
dialogues.challenge: Not to stay. But I'll fight you.
dialogues.accept: Then step through. Mind the edges. They are sharp.
dialogues.farewell: Somewhere is so... crowded.

lines: I have seen the space between stars. It looked back.
Nothing. It never says anything. That is what makes it so loud.
dialogues.challenge: Let's make some noise of our own.
dialogues.accept: The rift opens. Try not to fall in.
dialogues.farewell: Goodbye is only a word for 'see you in the dark.'

lines: Hello. Goodbye. Hello again. Time is strange near me.
Did we? I've already beaten you twice.
dialogues.challenge: Then this'll be the third time. Or not.
dialogues.accept: Third time. First time. It's all the same in the void.
dialogues.decline: Let's not make it a third.
dialogues.farewell: Then I will see you yesterday.

lines: Before you were born, there was nothing. I remember it.
Nothing is very hard to forget.
dialogues.challenge: Show me what nothing can do.
dialogues.accept: Everything. That's the secret. Come.
dialogues.farewell: Something always ends. Nothing never does.

lines: Your shadow is a little behind you. Did you notice?
Never mind. It will catch up. Shall we fight while we wait?
dialogues.accept: Wonderful. Don't look behind you.
dialogues.decline: I'm going to go find my shadow.
dialogues.farewell: Check under the bed. They like it there.

lines: Oh! A visitor! How delightful. Have you come to dance or to duel?
dialogues.accept: Marvelous! Do try to keep up!
dialogues.farewell: Wallflowers are lovely too. In their way.

lines: Riddle me this: what has a blade, a grin, and has never lost a duel?
Clever! You get one point. I get all the others.
dialogues.accept: A wager! Oh, the glamour of it!
dialogues.farewell: One point to you, then. Treasure it.

lines: Do you know the price of a fae bargain?
Only if you lose! And you would never lose. Would you?
dialogues.accept: Sealed with a smile! Let the game begin!
dialogues.farewell: A pity. I had such a lovely price in mind.

lines: I caught a little starlight in a jar once. I simply borrowed some.
I'll give it back. Eventually. Possibly.
dialogues.accept: Ooh, a thief-catcher! How thrilling!
dialogues.decline: Not my starlight, not my problem.
dialogues.farewell: Spoken like a true mortal. Toodle-oo!

lines: Shh. Listen. The flowers are gossiping about you.
That you'll lose spectacularly. Shall we prove them right?
dialogues.accept: Even better! The flowers adore a twist!
dialogues.decline: Tell the flowers I said hi.
dialogues.farewell: They say hello back. And something rude.

lines: I wanted to be found. Now you cannot unfind me.
dialogues.accept: As you wish. The lights go out.
dialogues.decline: I'll pretend I didn't see you.
dialogues.farewell: You won't see me leave, either.

lines: Every light casts a shadow. Every shadow is mine.
Especially yours. It told me your weaknesses.
dialogues.accept: Shadows never lie. Begin.
dialogues.decline: I'll go stand in the sun.
dialogues.farewell: The sun sets, challenger. Always.

lines: Are you going to say anything?
Words are noise. Noise gets you found. Found gets you beaten.
dialogues.challenge: Then let's skip to the beating.
dialogues.accept: Finally. Someone who understands.
dialogues.decline: I'll leave you to your silence.

lines: Every night, the sun closes its eyes, and the world goes dark.
I am what moves in that dark.
I'm not afraid of the dark.
dialogues.accept: You will be. Blink, and it begins.
dialogues.farewell: A rare combination. Keep it.

lines: I have watched you since you entered the clearing.
That's training. Shall I show you what else I learned?
dialogues.accept: Watch closely. You won't see it coming.
dialogues.farewell: No. You haven't. But you will.

lines: One thousand blades, each inscribed with a different rune. Would you like a demonstration?
Don't be absurd. Nine hundred should suffice.
dialogues.accept: Excellent. Do take notes, if you survive.
dialogues.farewell: Chapter one: do not challenge the Archon unprepared.

lines: Magic is merely mathematics with a flair for drama.
So what's the equation for beating you?
Unsolved. Many have attempted it. Care to try?
dialogues.accept: Show your work, challenger.
dialogues.farewell: Then study. The runes are patient teachers.

lines: I have studied every spell ever recorded, in every library I could find.
And yet I have found no record of anyone defeating me.
dialogues.accept: Bold. Let us draft that chapter together.
dialogues.farewell: Blank pages are the saddest kind.

lines: Your aura is... untidy. Unfocused. Quite frankly, a mess.
It wasn't a compliment. Allow me to correct it.
dialogues.accept: Lesson begins. Pay attention.
dialogues.farewell: Chaos has its charms. Few of them, but some.

lines: Every rune on my blades is a word. Together, they write a sentence.
'You have lost.' Let us see if it holds true.
dialogues.accept: Ah, an editor. Very well. Begin!
dialogues.farewell: Grammar wins again.

lines: Kneel, traveler. You stand before the throne of the sun.
Then you will burn standing. How dignified.
dialogues.challenge: I came to challenge your throne.
dialogues.accept: Then let the dawn judge you!
dialogues.farewell: Retreat beneath my light. It suits you.

lines: My dynasty has ruled since the first sunrise. The sun itself crowned us.
Many have tried. The sun still rises on my reign.
dialogues.accept: Presumptuous! I shall enjoy correcting you.
dialogues.farewell: Indeed. Long and bright.

lines: Do you feel that warmth? That is my favor.
Brilliance usually is. Few can stand in it for long.
dialogues.accept: Then shine, challenger, if you can.
dialogues.farewell: Shade is for the humble. Go, humble one.

lines: Scribes will write of this day. Will they write of your glory, or your defeat?
Then go ahead. Earn it. The sun is watching.
dialogues.accept: Let it be written! Begin!
dialogues.decline: Maybe they can write about something else.
dialogues.farewell: They will write that you left. Briefly.

lines: You cast a long shadow, traveler.
Flattery! How refreshing. It won't save you.
dialogues.accept: As you wish. Sunfire, rise!
dialogues.farewell: It was. Go in light.
